Suggested departure 08:00–08:30 · Approx. 4–5 hours driving, plus the camp transfer.

After breakfast, follow the valley toward "Tinghir", pausing above the palm groves before walking beneath the cliffs at "Todra Gorge". Continue through "Tinjdad", with a lunch stop along the way, then travel through "Erfoud" toward "Merzouga". Arrive with time to prepare for the dunes. A camel ride takes you toward camp as the afternoon light softens; settle into your tent before dinner and an evening beneath the desert sky.

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; dinner included; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: Quad biking is optional and charged separately. If you prefer a 4×4 camp transfer to a camel ride, request it before booking so availability and any difference in price are clear.

Suggested road departure 07:00–07:30, adjusted for sunrise · Approx. 9–10 hours driving.

Wake early if you would like to see the dunes at sunrise, then have breakfast and return to the road. Pass "Rissani" and "Alnif" before continuing through "Nkob" toward the palm-lined "Draa Valley". Take a lunch break en route and continue through "Agdz" and "Ouarzazate". Cross the "High Atlas" for an evening arrival in "Marrakech". This is a full travel day: stops are for meals, comfort and brief photographs rather than extended sightseeing.

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; no dinner included after the journey ends; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: No extra excursion is planned today. Keep dinner and onward travel in "Marrakech" flexible; mountain traffic and weather can make the return later.

Departure arranged around your arrival · Approx. 1½–2 hours intercity driving, plus local transfers.

Meet your driver in "Casablanca" and plan the first stops around your arrival time. If the schedule allows, pause on the waterfront near "Hassan II Mosque" before continuing north to "Rabat". Settle into your hotel or riad, with time for a short walk near the "Kasbah of the Udayas" or a relaxed evening after your flight.

Meals: Breakfast before pickup is not included; dinner inclusion will be specified in your proposal; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: An interior visit to "Hassan II Mosque" needs a suitable visiting slot and a separate ticket. It is optional and may not fit a late arrival.

Suggested departure 08:00–08:30 · Approx. 4–5 hours driving.

Begin with "Rabat"’s "Hassan Tower" area and the "Kasbah of the Udayas", allowing time to walk and take in the river views. Continue to "Meknes" for a lunch break and a look at the imperial city’s public squares. At "Volubilis", explore the Roman streets and surviving mosaics before continuing to "Fes" for the night. Access to individual monuments depends on opening and restoration work.

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; dinner inclusion will be specified in your proposal; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: "Volubilis" and other monument entrance tickets are paid separately. Visits inside additional monuments can be arranged if time allows.

Begin around "Bab Boujloud" and continue into "Fes el-Bali", where food stalls, workshops and narrow lanes reveal the medina’s daily rhythm. Pause around the historic madrasa quarter, then explore artisan streets and look toward the tanneries from an accessible terrace. Allow a leisurely lunch break and time to browse before returning to your accommodation. The route can be shortened to suit the heat and walking pace.

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; dinner inclusion will be specified in your proposal; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: Madrasa admission, terrace charges and purchases are separate. "Al-Qarawiyyin" is appreciated from publicly accessible areas; interior access is restricted. A cooking session is an optional extra.

Pause for lunch around "Midelt" before following the road toward the "Ziz Valley". Look out across the palm groves from a roadside viewpoint, then continue through "Errachidia" to "Erfoud". Check into your hotel on the desert edge and leave the evening free to rest before tomorrow’s journey into the dunes.

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; dinner inclusion will be specified in your proposal; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: Entrance tickets, lunch and drinks are paid separately. No additional activity is required to enjoy this day.

Suggested departure 09:30 · Approx. 1–2 hours driving, plus the camp transfer.

After lunch and some time to settle, prepare for the dunes. Travel toward camp by camel in the softer afternoon light, then enjoy dinner and your overnight in the desert.

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; dinner included; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: Quad biking and extended 4×4 excursions are optional and charged separately. A 4×4 alternative to the camel transfer can be requested before booking.

strings.Arrive near the medina entrance, with ar: Arrive near the medina entrance, with around four hours to explore. Wander independently or follow a medina visit arranged in advance.
strings.Follow narrow lanes past workshops and g: Follow narrow lanes past workshops and galleries, then walk the "Skala" ramparts for views of the "Atlantic". Look out for thuya woodwork and silver jewelry along the way.
strings.Stroll among the blue fishing boats befo: Stroll among the blue fishing boats before choosing lunch near the port or in the medina. Grilled seafood is a natural choice here. Lunch is payable separately unless included in your quote.
strings.Walk along the sandy beach, return to a: Walk along the sandy beach, return to a favorite shop or enjoy mint tea on "Place Moulay Hassan". Leave a little time simply to sit and watch the town go by.
strings.Your driver meets you near the medina en: Your driver meets you near the medina entrance for the journey inland. With breaks along the way, expect to reach your accommodation between 19:00 and 20:00.
strings.Your driver meets you at your accommodat: Your driver meets you at your accommodation for an early departure. Climb into the mountains past terraced hillsides and villages overlooking the road.
strings.Pause at viewpoints around the 2,260-met: Pause at viewpoints around the 2,260-metre pass. Take in the peaks and the road winding below before descending toward the southern kasbahs.
strings.Explore the fortified village on foot, f: Explore the fortified village on foot, following earthen lanes toward the granary at the top. Enjoy the valley views and look for settings you may recognize from film and television.
strings.Continue to Ouarzazate and Taourirt Kasb: Continue to "Ouarzazate" and "Taourirt Kasbah". If you’ve chosen to visit the "Atlas Film Studios", explore the sets along the way. Studio admission is an optional extra.
strings.Take a seat at a local restaurant for ta: Take a seat at a local restaurant for tagine, couscous or grilled dishes. Lunch and drinks are payable separately unless included in your quote.
strings.Cross the Atlas once more, with a differ: Cross the "Atlas" once more, with a different light on the slopes. A stop at an argan cooperative can be added on request if time allows.
strings.Return to your accommodation or agreed m: Return to your accommodation or agreed meeting point, with the evening ahead after a full day in the mountains.
strings.Your driver will meet you at your hotel: Your driver will meet you at your hotel or the nearest accessible parking in the Medina. Set off for "Agafay" in comfort, with transport arranged just for you and your companions.
strings.Be welcomed and set the perfect mood for: Be welcomed and set the perfect mood for the evening.
strings.Enjoy the breathtaking views as the sun: Enjoy the breathtaking views as the sun sets over the "Agafay Desert", creating a golden hue over the rocky terrain.
strings.Indulge in a delicious 3-course Moroccan: Indulge in a delicious 3-course Moroccan dinner, featuring a variety of local flavors and specialties.
strings.Experience an enchanting Berber show wit: Experience an enchanting Berber show with traditional music and performances, adding to the magic of the desert night.
strings.After an unforgettable evening, we drive: After an unforgettable evening, we drive you back to your accommodation, ensuring a seamless end to your desert adventure.
strings.Your driver meets you for the day’s jour: Your driver meets you for the day’s journey by 4×4. Head southwest, stopping to take in the views as farmland gives way to "Agafay"’s rocky hills.
strings.Join the camel team for an hour among st: Join the camel team for an hour among stony hills and dry valleys, with the "Atlas Mountains" stretching across the horizon.
strings.Pause by the water for photographs and a: Pause by the water for photographs and a quiet moment before the road begins to climb.
strings.Look out over terraces and hillside sett: Look out over terraces and hillside settlements, then visit a Berber family for mint tea and homemade bread. On Saturdays, the route also takes in "Asni"’s weekly market.
strings.Begin a one- to two-hour walk through wa: Begin a one- to two-hour walk through walnut terraces, hamlets and streams toward the waterfalls. The pace is set to suit everyone traveling with you.
strings.Enjoy a three-course Moroccan lunch in I: Enjoy a three-course Moroccan lunch in "Imlil" with views over the valley: salad, tagine or couscous, followed by fruit and mint tea.
strings.Return through Moulay Brahim Gorge and t: Return through "Moulay Brahim Gorge" and the "Asni" area. The drive takes around an hour and a half, bringing you back to "Marrakech" for the evening.
strings.Leave Fes early from the meeting point a: Leave "Fes" early from the meeting point agreed near your riad and travel north toward the "Rif Mountains".
strings.Explore the blue medina on foot, with ti: Explore the blue medina on foot, with time for photographs, small squares and lunch at a place that takes your fancy.
strings.Meet your driver for the return to Fes,: Meet your driver for the return to "Fes", or continue your stay in "Chefchaouen" if you’ve arranged a one-way journey.
strings.Travel from Fes to Volubilis and explore: Travel from "Fes" to "Volubilis" and explore the Roman site. A local introduction to its history can be arranged if you’d like more context.
strings.Continue to nearby Moulay Idriss for a s: Continue to nearby "Moulay Idriss" for a short visit and a pause for lunch.
strings.Discover the accessible landmarks of Mek: Discover the accessible landmarks of "Meknes" before returning to "Fes" at the end of the day.
strings.Travel to the launch area before sunrise: Travel to the launch area before sunrise and meet the team for your briefing and the morning’s preparations.
Take to the sky when conditions permit. The operator will confirm the flight time, which is shorter than the complete morning outing.

strings.Choose between a traditional bathhouse a: Choose between a traditional bathhouse and a spa, with privacy and treatments agreed before your visit.

strings.Return at the agreed time, with your tra: Return at the agreed time, with your transfer planned in advance if requested.
strings.Meet the stable team, talk through your: Meet the stable team, talk through your riding experience and receive a helmet and introductory instructions.
strings.Follow the stable team along a suitable: Follow the stable team along a suitable coastal trail at the agreed pace. The day’s conditions determine access to the beach.
strings.Return to the stable and finish the outi: Return to the stable and finish the outing locally, ready to enjoy the rest of your time in "Essaouira".
strings.Tell us whether you prefer surfing or ki: Tell us whether you prefer surfing or kitesurfing, your swimming ability and any previous experience. Agree the lesson format, meeting point and equipment in advance. Allow a half day for preparation, your session and a little time to unwind.
strings.Meet the activity team at the confirmed: Meet the activity team at the confirmed beach. Review the sea conditions, fit your equipment and begin with a briefing. Surf lessons introduce paddling and standing up; a first kitesurf lesson starts with kite control and the steps appropriate to your level.
strings.Follow your instructor through a session: Follow your instructor through a session adapted to the conditions and your progress. Beginners build confidence gradually; experienced participants work on the goals agreed with their instructor. The amount of water time depends on the chosen sport and the weather.
strings.Return your equipment and take a moment: Return your equipment and take a moment beside the ocean. Continue with a beach walk or head back to "Essaouira" for lunch and the medina at your own pace. Meals and any onward transport are separate.
strings.Share your preferred sport, swimming abi: Share your preferred sport, swimming ability and experience. Agree the lesson format and meeting point with the activity team. Surfing and kitesurfing have different requirements; kitesurf availability and the suitable beach are checked before confirmation.
strings.Meet your activity team and review the d: Meet your activity team and review the day’s conditions. The session may take place at a suitable beach near "Taghazout" rather than directly in the village. Fit the agreed equipment and begin with a briefing and beach practice.
strings.For surfing, practice the techniques app: For surfing, practice the techniques appropriate to your level with your instructor’s guidance. For a confirmed kitesurf session, follow a progression based on your experience and the wind, beginning with kite control if you are new to the sport. A particular break or riding milestone is not guaranteed.
strings.Finish at the agreed point, return your: Finish at the agreed point, return your equipment and leave time to enjoy the coast. A seaside lunch, a walk through "Taghazout" or a quiet hour watching the waves makes an easy finish. Meals and any extra transport are separate.

strings.Suggested departure 07:30–08:00 · Approx:
Suggested departure 07:30–08:00 · Approx. 6–7 hours driving.

Leave "Marrakech" as the road begins to climb through the "High Atlas". Pause at safe viewpoints around "Tizi n’Tichka" before descending to "Aït Ben Haddou". Walk through the earthen lanes and, if you wish, climb toward the upper viewpoint. After a lunch break, continue through "Ouarzazate" and past the palm groves of "Skoura". The road follows the "Rose Valley" through "Kelaat M’Gouna" before reaching "Dades", where there is time to settle in before dinner.

Meals: Breakfast before pickup is not included; dinner included; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: Atlas Studios are an optional, ticketed addition. Adding this visit requires adjusting the stops and arrival time.
strings.Suggested departure 08:00 · Approx. 6–7:
Suggested departure 08:00 · Approx. 6–7 hours driving.

Follow the "Rose Valley" through "Kelaat M’Gouna" after breakfast, then continue past "Skoura"’s palm groves to "Ouarzazate". At "Aït Ben Haddou", leave the road for a walk through the old earthen settlement and a lunch break nearby. The afternoon takes you over the "High Atlas", with short viewpoint pauses when conditions allow, before arriving in "Marrakech".

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; dinner inclusion will be specified in your proposal; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: Atlas Studios can be added by prior arrangement, with tickets paid separately. This visit requires an earlier start or a later arrival.
strings.Suggested departure 09:00 · Approx. 1½–2:
Suggested departure 09:00 · Approx. 1½–2½ hours driving.

After breakfast, continue to "Ouarzazate" for a pause around the old kasbah quarter. Follow the road east to "Skoura", where palms and earthen buildings replace the open, rocky plain. Check into your accommodation and spend the afternoon on a gentle walk through the oasis lanes, with time to rest between visits.

Meals: Breakfast included at your overnight accommodation; dinner inclusion will be specified in your proposal; lunch and drinks are not included.

Optional & separate costs: Entry to Taourirt Kasbah or Atlas Studios is optional and charged separately. Choose the visits you want rather than filling the day with every available stop.
